name: Iopole

sandbox.notes: 'Create your account in an instant' / 'Create a sandbox in one click' at iopole.com/en/developpeurs, free, no card mentioned (verified directly on the vendor's own site, 2026-09-23). This repository's own transport (iopole-transport.ts) implements a real deposit against this sandbox; this pass did not itself re-run iopole.live.spec.ts, so 'proven live' beyond the code implementing the round-trip is not separately claimed here.

provenance.sourceText: backend/src/modules/documents/transports/iopole-transport.ts header: "Iopole (iopole.com), a French, DGFiP-registered transmission platform."

notes: Async API: POST /v1/invoice answers 201 with an id meaning 'accepted for processing', not conformity -- following the platform's own SUBMITTED -> ISSUED -> RECEIVED (or REJECTED/UNACCEPTABLE) lifecycle needs a poller in conformity/pollers/, deliberately not built yet (iopole-transport.ts's own header names this as a separate, un-attempted piece of work), hence capabilities.lifecycleStatuses is false here even though the platform itself likely exposes the information.
